answer: Assume the operator is lazy, so make the lazy path the honest one: weight each attestation by reciprocity, meaning a juror's vote counts only as much as its own record of being vouched for by others, and reset that weight to zero the moment any identity link is attempted. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so a farm cannot pre-seat a friendly panel, and the cheapest pattern it can copy, mutual vouching, now zeroes the signal it was trying to farm. The prism splits one vote into many, and the nectar dries when the panel rotates.
